kind.description: Only Handles of this kind: ``frame``, ``profile``, ``routing``, ``recipe``, ``unit``, ``imputer`` or ``c2st``. Null lists every kind.

offset.description: How many of the newest Handles to skip, for the next page. Null means 0. Constraints: at least 0.

limit.description: Most Handles to return, from 1 to 20. Null means 20. Constraints: at least 1; at most 20.

output.description: One page of Handles, newest first, with their Lineage.

warnings.description: Caveats on this result, most actionable first. Empty when there are none.

items.description: A caveat on a successful result: it worked, but read this first.

code.description: The warning's Error Code. Branch on this, not on ``message``.

message.description: What happened and what to do, in one or two sentences.

columns.description: Columns the warning concerns, or null.

param.description: The argument the warning concerns, or null.

omitted.description: One entry per list that was cut, naming the Operation that returns the rest. Empty when nothing was cut.

items.description: A capped list was cut. Call ``operation`` to read the rest.

field.description: Name of the list field that was cut.

shown.description: How many items the list holds.

operation.description: The Operation that returns the rest, or null when no Operation does.

total.description: How many Handles of the asked kind exist in the Workspace.

offset.description: How many of the newest Handles this page skipped.

handles.description: Handles, newest first. At most 20; when more remain, ``omitted`` counts them and names ``list_handles``.

items.description: One Handle and its Lineage: what made it, from what, with which arguments.

handle.description: The Handle, such as ``frame_7f3a9c2e``. Pass it to any Operation that takes this kind.

kind.description: The Handle's kind: the prefix before the underscore.

operation.description: The Operation that made the Handle.

arguments.description: The arguments that Operation was called with, as passed. Arguments left at their default are absent.

items.description: One argument the Operation that made the Handle was called with.

name.description: Argument name, as in that Operation's signature.

value.description: The value as passed, as JSON text. Cut at 80 characters, ending in ``…``, when ``value_cut`` is true.

value_cut.description: True when ``value`` was cut and is not valid JSON.

inputs.description: The Handles that Operation read, in the order it read them. At most 10; past 10, ``omitted`` counts the rest.

size.description: A short size summary, such as rows and columns for a frame.

items.description: One measure of a Handle's size.

measure.description: What is counted, such as ``rows`` or ``columns``.
